describe.description: A single quadrupedal mammal is shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background, standing with its body arched and its long tapering tail extending to the rear. The animal has an elongated narrow snout with a dark nostril at the tip, a small dark eye, and a low, robust body supported by four short sturdy limbs ending in large curved claws. Most of the dorsal surface, head top, outer limbs and tail are covered in overlapping dark brown to grayish keratinous scales with lighter edges, arranged like shingles. Large irregular patches of pale pink, wrinkled bare skin are visible on the mid-back, mid-flank, and rear flank where scales are absent, as well as paler skin on the underside and lower limbs. The texture of scales, skin, and claws is rendered in fine detail, with dirt around the feet.

describe.description: A stocky quadrupedal mammal shown in right side profile with a highly arched back, covered in overlapping dark brown to gray keratin scales except for several large pale pink smooth hairless patches on the back, flank and rump. It has a small elongated head tapering to a blunt pointed snout with a dark nose, a small round dark eye, and a small rounded external ear. Its underside and parts of the legs are pale gray-tan wrinkled skin. It stands on four short sturdy legs ending in broad paws with long curved dark claws, and has a long tapering scaly tail extending back along the ground behind it.
